content:
Latest news, Eastern Time 7:37 PM: Apple says all issues have been resolved except for Apple TV.

Apple is currently reporting problems with Apple TV and subscription purchases, with some users also experiencing issues with other company services. Details below.

Apple is currently listing 8 ongoing issues

Apple's system status page currently lists Apple TV, App Store, Apple Fitness+, Apple Music, Apple Music Subscriptions, Mac App Store, and subscription purchases as experiencing outages or other ongoing issues.

According to Apple, most issues began at 4:22 PM Eastern Time. The company lists the App Store, Apple Music, and Mac App Store as undergoing "routine maintenance, not expected to impact users," while the Apple TV outage began at 4:43 PM Eastern Time, with Apple noting the service "may be temporarily unavailable due to scheduled maintenance."

During our testing, the Apple TV interface failed to load on iOS, but content still loaded and played normally on other devices.

The outage began shortly after multiple apps—including TestFlight, App Store, and Fitness+—started replacing normal interface text with internal localization strings. It is currently unclear whether this is related to the other issues Apple systems are experiencing.

Downdetector reports further confirm Apple TV is affected, although the number of reports appears to have peaked and begun declining, suggesting the outage may be gradually subsiding.

We will continue to monitor the situation and update this report as more information becomes available or once Apple marks the issues as resolved.

Are you experiencing issues too? Let us know in the comments.

Amazon products worth keeping an eye on

  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 5
  • AirTag (2nd generation) — 4-pack
  • MacBook Neo
  • Logitech MX Master 4
